evidence.fact: Off-the-shelf OKR agents already generate structured objectives and key results aligned to a stated vision, for teams or businesses. This covers the drafting sub-step end to end.
Agent workflows can analyze past goals and key business metrics and then recommend realistic objectives and key results. The manager still has to choose priorities and accept the result.

Mainstream goal-management platforms such as Asana and Lattice link goals to projects and performance reviews, so drafted goals and deadlines can go straight into existing systems. Vendor AI features were not checked against official documentation.

Commercial AI takeoff tools (ConstructConnect Takeoff Boost, Togal.AI, Trimble, Handoff H1 in July 2026) read blueprints and produce quantity and material takeoffs automatically. Most of the speed and accuracy figures come from the vendors, and estimators' work is moving toward reviewing the AI's output.
Handoff says its H1 model does autonomous blueprint takeoffs and matches experienced estimators on residential plans. This claim comes from a press release and has not been independently checked.

Cost estimating is generally not a licensed occupation in Canada, though certification is often expected. Registration is required only in a few places, such as for quantity surveyors in Victoria, Australia. I did not check US or UK rules in this search.

O*NET lists this as a core sonographer duty: preparing the patient, explaining the procedure, moving the patient onto the table, cleaning the skin, applying gel and positioning the patient. Nearly all of these steps are hands-on work done with the patient in the room.

Commercial conversational AI (for example, Patient Prism) can give radiology exam preparation instructions and answer patients' questions before the exam. That covers only the explaining part of the task. The vendor's claims have not been independently evaluated.

Studies of AI-generated information about abdominal ultrasound find that it is fast, but its accuracy and reliability are still uncertain. A commentary recommends using chatbots only to supplement human patient education.
Retorio sells retail-focused AI roleplay in which virtual customers push back, object and surprise trainees during objection-handling and upselling practice. This is vendor marketing.

Born Digital's AI roleplay tools for store and call-center staff score tone, accuracy, empathy, policy compliance and how the situation was resolved, so an agent could run the practice and feedback steps on its own. This is vendor marketing.

RetailDoc's SalesRX offers AI roleplay training for retail associates. Its customer case study reports that 99% of associates said they improved, which is a self-reported vendor figure. The supervisor still has to watch live sales on the floor and coach in person.

Rental technician job postings describe the work as hands-on: setting bindings to the boot and to safety standards (sometimes with certification), fitting boots with a foot sizer, and checking gear for damage before and after rental.
Texada (vendor-reported, launched March 2026) offers AI damage detection that compares check-out and check-in photos. A person still has to take the photos and do any repair or adjustment.
Record360's 360AI is human-in-the-loop: the AI flags possible damage and people make the final call, so it only assists with the inspection step.
